advisories.summary: A network capture found this version contacting GitHub at every start, to download plugins from the ONLYOFFICE marketplace, and its welcome page loading a font from Google. Its review said nothing leaves the server.
advisories.remediation: Update ONLYOFFICE to package 0.2.6, which turns both off. No documents left the server.

advisories.summary: A network capture found Stirling PDF's pages loading Stripe's payment library, which sends fraud-detection signals about the browser, along with PostHog's error reporting and Iconify's icons. Its review said nothing leaves.
advisories.remediation: Update Stirling PDF to package 0.2.7, which keeps PostHog and Stripe on your server. Its pages still fetch icons from Iconify.

advisories.summary: The web vault checks passwords against Have I Been Pwned, at sign-up and when a login is opened, which this version's review said was inactive. Only the first five characters of each password's hash are sent.
advisories.remediation: Update Vaultwarden to package 0.4.1, whose review lists the check. At sign-up the box can be unticked.
